content.short: A new NFT project on the Cardano blockchain.
content.description:
New NFT project on the Cardano blockchain. We have big ideas and visions.

The Mute Mutants is a collection of 4444 uniquely generated pieces of art with, 79 different backgrounds, 66 different characters, 77 different assets (hair, hats, tails, ears, wings etc.), 15 different eyes, making it around 6 million different combinations, bringing hypebeast to the nft space combining an original character with pop culture, some being rarer than others.

Demonstrating each character is unique in their own way, thus bringing in more diversity and inclusivity.
